title: Monthly Strategic Signal Digest & Decision Ask Package
creator: Maya Patel
description: Purpose: Produce a compact, executive-friendly monthly readout packet that synthesizes cross-functional signals (latency/cost trends, Dedicated capacity utilization, Private deployment adoption) and surfaces three prioritized decision asks with supporting trade-offs and fallback lanes. Goal is to reduce meeting time for execs while giving clear actionables and contingency plans for Board / QBR discussion. This is intentionally a concise packet (10 slides + appendix) emphasizing: 1) one-page signal digest, 2) prioritized asks with ask-level metrics and consequences, 3) risk heatmap and mitigation lanes. Deliverables: single PDF deck, 1-page TL;DR memo, slide appendix with data sources and full dashboard links.
acceptance_criteria: Single PDF deck <= 12 slides including appendix
TL;DR one-pager summarizing three asks, each with explicit metrics and ask owner
Data provenance appendix with links to dashboards and raw queries
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Design, and Growth at least 24 hours before readout
Contingency lanes documented for each ask (best-case, baseline, fallback)
decisions: Recommend prioritizing Dedicated autoscaling polish (batching edge cases) as Ask #1 for predictable Q2 throughput
Propose a near-term $150k pilot budget for Private on-prem packaging to validate regulated customer flow as Ask #2
Defer investment in new embedding reranking model until after runtime-1.20 performance gates are met; provide fallback policy instead for Ask #3
